title: A pharmacist complies with all elements of a drug's FDA-required REMS
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(21), a pharmacist shall comply with all elements of a drug's FDA required risk evaluation and mitigation strategy ("REMS"), including any distribution or dispensing restriction included in its REMS.
exam_relevance: Tests that the Board's practice standards require a pharmacist to comply with all elements of a drug's FDA-required REMS, expressly including distribution and dispensing restrictions.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
